## Review matrix

| Dimension | Required evidence | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Hierarchy | 390 / 768 / 1440 下 Current Objective 与唯一认证行动始终先于次要信息 | pending |
| Motion grammar | Focus → Commit → Resolve → World Reaction → New Objective 可被视觉追踪，且不依赖循环或纯淡入 | pending |
| Deduction feel | 证据、证词、矛盾和理论连接具有明确因果手感，不像普通表单 | pending |
| Noir coherence | theatre light、rain-black surfaces、brass/cyan/rust 信号与现有 Midnight Chorus 资产一致 | pending |
| Content fit | cover / map / finale 与实际槽位裁切、密度和文案层级匹配 | pending |
| Accessibility | focus ring、44px targets、对比度、键盘和屏幕阅读顺序可接受 | pending |
| Low Sensory | 关闭高刺激动效后信息和操作完整，不用颜色或声音单独编码 | pending |
| Authority clarity | UI 不暗示 presentation 可以决定 truth、证据覆盖或 judgement | pending |

## Decision

- Decision：`approved / changes-required / human-pending`
